entities.summary: The Independent Democratic Action is a political party in São Tomé and Príncipe. It was established in 1994 by the then president Miguel Trovoada and is a politically centrist party. Independent Democratic Action is a political party, established in 1992. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
